_readme: Random daily events (scripts/daily.gd). One rolls each morning unless the calendar day is a headline. No repeat within 'no_repeat' days. pool: weekday | weekend. Effects (all optional): energy/happy/money (applied on wake), shift_pay (multiplies shift pay), shift_modes (which shift buttons show), inspector (true = he shows up for sure), walk (outdoor walk speed x), spawn (enemy spawn rate x; 2 = twice as many), needs_beaten (only rolls after this many story bosses). 'note' = the fridge sticky that announces it (from = who wrote it). 'effect' = the small print under the sticky.

events.card: Health inspector at the {fork_nick} today. Clipboard energy.

note.text: Inspector's coming. Hide the good tongs.

events.effect: Inspector shows up at work. Shift pay x1.25.

events.card: Power's out on the block. The fridge is a coffin now.

note.text: Power's out. Don't open the fridge. I mean it. Not even to look.
She's warm. I've got her this morning. Short shift if you can?

events.effect: Quick Shift only. +5 Happiness for helping.

events.card: {cat1} and {cat2} knock the coffee off the counter. Unprovoked. Probably.

note.text: the cup was in the way. we stand by it.

events.card: One of the bosses I beat comes into the {fork_nick}. Tips like it's an apology.

note.text: Guess who's at table six tonight. Big tipper. Bigger loser.

events.card: Somebody's grandma is tipping in two-dollar bills.

note.text: Grandma special tonight? Bring me a two-dollar bill. For luck.

events.card: Brayden no-call no-showed. Again. The schedule bleeds.

note.text: Covering Brayden. Full shift. Love you, see you never.

events.card: Packages on every porch. Hoodies circling like gulls.

note.text: Three packages coming today. Guard them with your life. Or the pan.

events.card: First ice of the year. {city} turns into a rink.

note.text: Ice out there. Walk like a penguin. Penguins don't go to urgent care.

events.card: Wind chill's a war crime. My face files for asylum.

note.text: we are not going outside. you shouldn't either.
Market today!! Just one candle. Maybe two. Bring cash.

events.card: Sun's out. {baby} meets a duck. Both are horrified.

note.text: (a purple circle with legs. a duck, probably)

events.card: Earl's buddy needs a line cook for a wedding. Cash. No questions. Some questions.

note.text: Wedding gig this morning. Forty bucks and whatever cake survives.
today we nap. this is not a request.
